notes: Map fixes on the 3v3 maps. Polar Base: spies can climb the fence cage on the hangar roof, the ladders work, the stairs have real ramps (no more falling through or choppy steps), and spies can dive through the hut windows from both sides. Steel Squat: fire extinguishers and gas cylinders explode when shot, grenaded or hacked for 3 s by a spy; the wall the crane switch knocks down can now be walked through by everyone, not just the host; the two breakable doors break; clotheslines and wires no longer hold you up; the sky is back; smoother stairs; two broken ledges fixed. Factory: every ladder now lets you step off at the top. Prison: window ledges sit on the sill and on both sides, floating ledges fixed, smoother stairs. New terminal spots on Polar Base, Steel Squat, Factory and Prison. Everyone in a match needs x71. Still to come: jumping over and pulling mercs off the Polar Base walkway railings, and ledge fixes on the other 3v3 maps.
